description: The FIND files predicate surface on the frozen Zephyr corpus: a numeric comparison on size, an exact path lookup, extension combined with an IN glob, and the heredoc form of a regex asserted equivalent to the inline form. clause_pipeline covers ORDER BY size DESC; these cover the filters that select which files are ordered at all. Note that a FIND files response carries no total field — the count the CSV renderer shows is not in the JSON — so these cases assert row_count and the rows themselves.

cases.name: size_comparison_selects_files_above_a_threshold
cases.fql: FIND files WHERE size > 50000 ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT 5

cases.name: extension_and_in_glob_narrow_together
cases.fql: FIND files WHERE extension = 'h' IN 'kernel/**' ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT 3

steps.fql: SHOW LINES 51-75 OF 'kernel/sched.c' WHERE text MATCHES 'void \*\w+_runq'

SHOW LINES 51-75 OF 'kernel/sched.c' WHERE text MATCHES <<RE
void \*\w+_runq
RE
